page.title: Home
page.subtitle: What your last week is actually telling you.

worksWithout: Everything else on Home works without this.

setup.title: Add your AI key to get insights
setup.description: Connect an OpenAI-compatible key in Settings and Home will turn your recent activity, journal, and habit stats into a short summary and a few concrete suggestions.

hero.label: AI insight
hero.basedOn: Based on the last 7 days · your key, your model
hero.fallbackSummary: {{percent}}% of your intentions were met over the last {{days}} days.
hero.fallbackNoFigures: Here is where your week stands.

notice.stale: This was written from numbers that have since changed. A fresh one is on its way, or refresh it yourself.
notice.offline: You're offline, so this is the last insight we had. It will refresh when you're back.

evidence.title: What this was made from
evidence.sent: Only these numbers were sent to your AI provider. Names of your habits are included; your journal and tasks never are.

digest.title: Worth acting on today
digest.subtitle: From your own last 7 days. No AI needed.
digest.allClear: Nothing is slipping and no streak is at risk. Carry on.
digest.nothingYet: Add a habit on Today and what's worth acting on will show up here.
digest.pinLabel: Pin {{name}} to the top of Today

journalStreak.evidence_one: {{count}} day in a row, up to yesterday
journalStreak.evidence_other: {{count}} days in a row, up to yesterday

suggestions.title: Your AI suggests
suggestions.written: Written by your model from the numbers above. Treat it as a suggestion.
suggestions.stale: Written from older numbers. Refresh the insight for current suggestions.
suggestions.allDismissed: You've set these aside. A new insight brings new suggestions.
suggestions.inactive: This habit is archived or removed, so there's nothing to do here.
suggestions.grounded: Written by your model. Each one is about a single habit and may cite only that habit's own figures; anything else it said was left out.

error.title: Couldn't make an insight
error.unknown: Something went wrong. Try again in a moment.
error.rateLimited: You've hit today's AI insight limit — try again tomorrow.
error.notConfigured: AI isn't set up yet. Add your key in Settings.
error.providerRejected: Your AI provider rejected the request ({{status}}): {{detail}}
error.providerUnreachable: Couldn't reach your AI provider. Check the base URL in Settings, then try again.
error.providerEmpty: Your AI provider answered with nothing. Check the model name in Settings.
error.providerInvalid: The AI didn't return a usable answer. Try again in a moment.

offline.title: AI insights need a connection
offline.description: Insights are made through your account, so they come back when you're online.
